[[Toru Sakurai]] ([[SM106]]-present) |enva1= }} '''Kiawe's Charizard''' (Japanese: '''カキのリザードン''' ''Kaki's Lizardon'') was one of the two original {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Kiawe}} in the [[Alola]] [[region]] prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', having received it from his [[Kiawe's grandfather|grandfather]]. Kiawe often uses it as a [[Poké Ride|Ride Pokémon]]. ==In animation== ==={{aniseries|SM}}=== ====With Kiawe's grandfather==== [[File:Kiawe Charizard Grandfather.png|thumb|left|250px|Charizard with a younger Kiawe and his grandfather]] Prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', Charizard used to be owned by [[Kiawe's grandfather]]. Sometimes, he would take his grandson along for the ride to teach him how to fly Charizard. ====With Kiawe==== [[File:Kiawe milk delivery.png|thumb|250px|Charizard making a milk delivery]] Ever since Kiawe's grandfather gave Charizard to him, Kiawe has used it as transport, usually from his home on [[Akala Island]] to [[Melemele Island]], to attend the [[Pokémon School]]. He also uses it to deliver his family's dairy products to places on Akala and other islands in [[Alola]]. It first appeared in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', where [[Team Skull]] members [[Tupp]], [[Rapp]], and [[Zipp]] tried beating Kiawe in a battle so they could steal Charizard. While Kiawe beat them with {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}}, Charizard laid down and relaxed, unworried about the battle. Starting in ''[[SM061|A Mission of Ultra Urgency!]]'', Charizard has been used by Kiawe as his Ride Pokémon during the [[Ultra Guardians]] missions. In ''[[SM078|Twirling with a Bang!]]'', it helped to create the Super Special Pokémon Fireworks move, distracting the wild {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Xurkitree}} and {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Blacephalon}} long enough for them to be captured. In ''[[SM086|I Choose Paradise!]]'', Charizard joined the rest of the Ride Pokémon on a trip to the [[Pokémon Paradise Resort]] for a day of relaxation. During the day, Charizard enjoyed a hot spring and massage alongside his Trainer. Later in the day {{TRT}} stole some of the group's Pokémon but failed to restrain the Ride Pokémon. Together, they managed to rescue them and used a combined attack to blast Team Rocket off. [[File:Ultra Guardians Ride Pokémon.png|thumb|left|250px|Charizard with the other Ride Pokémon on an Ultra Guardians mission]] In ''[[SM088|Full Moon and Many Arms!]]'', Charizard joined the Ride Pokémon on a pursuit to stop {{an|Necrozma}} from attacking and absorbing {{an|Lunala}}. Charizard managed to hit it with Flamethrower, allowing {{p|Dragonair}}, {{p|Metang}}, and {{p|Flygon}} to attack it as well, though it shrugged the attacks off and retaliated. In ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', Charizard joined the rest of Alola in showering Necrozma with light so it could return to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|normal form}}. [[File:Kiawe Charizard battling Tapu Lele.png|thumb|250px|Charizard battling Tapu Lele]] In ''[[SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!]]'', Charizard was used to fly Kiawe from [[Poni Island]] to the [[Ruins of Life]] after Ash, his Pokémon, and the rest of Kiawe's Pokémon had been imprisoned by {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Fini}}. At the ruins, Kiawe encountered {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Lele}}, and begged it to give him some of its scales to save his friends, but it refused to do so without a battle. Without hesitation Charizard volunteered, but was no match against the Land Spirit Pokémon's {{type|Psychic}} attacks. After saving Kiawe from some collapsing ruins, the two fled into the air, only to be hit by Tapu Lele's {{m|Psybeam}}. Kiawe struggled to think of what to do, but remembered a lesson his grandfather had taught him, helping him to land a direct hit with Aerial Ace. Impressed with the two, Tapu Lele gave Kiawe some of its scales and left. Charizard then flew Kiawe back to Poni Island but was unable to return to the [[Ruins of Hope]]. Kiawe recalled Charizard and ran the rest of the way. At the ruins, Tapu Fini used the scales Kiawe had brought to heal Charizard and handed Kiawe a [[Flyinium Z]]. Kiawe and Charizard then performed {{m|Supersonic Skystrike}} together. In ''[[SM133|Battling on the Wing!]]'', Kiawe used Charizard in his [[Manalo Conference]] battle against {{an|Sophocles}}, where it went up against {{TP|Sophocles|Vikavolt}}. Charizard was able to dodge some of Vikavolt's attacks before being hit by a supereffective {{m|Zap Cannon}}, which left it {{status|Paralysis|paralyzed}}. Sophocles and Vikavolt then started to perform {{m|Savage Spin-Out}} on Charizard. The battle continued in the [[SM134|next episode]], where Charizard was able to break free from Savage Spin-Out with its fire. Although Vikavolt tried slowing Charizard down with its {{m|String Shot}}s, it was able to stop Vikavolt's following attack with {{m|Fire Punch}}. Eventually, Charizard managed to overpower Vikavolt's {{m|Wild Charge}} with Supersonic Skystrike, defeating it and allowing Kiawe to advance to the semifinals. In ''[[SM145|Dreams of the Sun and Moon!]]'', Kiawe used Charizard to battle Ash and his {{AP|Lycanroc}}. Following a clash of {{m|Inferno Overdrive}} and {{m|Splintered Stormshards}}, Lycanroc emerged victorious. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== Charizard appeared in a flashback in ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]''. Upon learning that Ash was returning to Alola, Kiawe had Charizard fly him to [[Wela Volcano Park|Wela Volcano]] for emergency training. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Kiawe and Charizard.png|thumb|250px|left|Charizard and Kiawe]] [[File:Kiawe Charizard Bath.png|thumb|250px|Charizard enjoying a bath at the hot springs]] Charizard is a very relaxed Pokémon. In ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', it chose to sleep where it was while Kiawe and his {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}} were battling [[Tupp]], [[Rapp]], and [[Zipp]] over its ownership. Although it is usually a calm Pokémon, it can become angry, as seen before Kiawe battled the {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s when they said they wanted to take Charizard for themselves. In the same episode, despite wanting to sleep, it perked up after {{Ash}} brought up the fact that he just spotted {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Koko}}. Much like the rest of Kiawe's Pokémon, it enjoys [[Poni Island]] radishes, as shown in ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]''. Unlike most Charizard, it is unafraid of water, as shown in ''[[SM086|I Choose Paradise!]]'' when it willingly entered a hot spring. Its Trainer even revealed that it likes to take long baths. {{-}} Charizard's immense stamina is evident in its multiple long-distance flights and its willingness to battle Tapu Lele without hesitation in ''[[SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!]]''. However, even its impressive endurance had limits, as it was too exhausted to return to the Ruins of Hope after its arduous journey back to Poni Island. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fire|flying|Kiawe Charizard {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Slash|2=Fire Punch|3=Aerial Ace}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Slash|2=Fire Punch|3=Aerial Ace}}}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|SM022|A Shivering Shovel Search!}} {{anmov|normal|Slash|SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!}} {{anmov|fire|Fire Punch|SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!}} {{anmov|flying|Aerial Ace|SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ====[[Z-Move]]s used==== {{anmov/h|fire|flying|Kiawe Charizard {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Supersonic Skystrike|1=Inferno Overdrive}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Supersonic Skystrike|1=Inferno Overdrive}}}} {{anmov|flying|Supersonic Skystrike|SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!{{tt|*|Base move is Aerial Ace}}}} {{anmov|fire|Inferno Overdrive|SM145|Dreams of the Sun and Moon!{{tt|*|Base move is Flamethrower or Fire Punch}}}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ====Moves improvised==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; border: 3px solid #{{flying color dark}}; {{roundy}}" |- !
